title: Tents and Nomadic Life
summary: Tents were common dwellings for patriarchal and pastoral life, showing mobility, hospitality, and dependence on God’s provision.
background: Patriarchal households often moved with flocks and servants. Tent scenes help readers understand travel, hospitality, family life, and the temporary nature of earthly dwelling.
teachingHelp: When a passage mentions tents, explain the setting as mobile household life rather than modern camping. This often highlights dependence, pilgrimage, and hospitality.
